'''1999 Decipher World Championship Bastian Winkelhaus LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls98.htm X-Mains], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031035837/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls98.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
